body.message:
The Urban Oasis 2BR is listed at AED 8,500/month, fully all-inclusive, that covers VAT, water, electricity, and internet, so nothing extra beyond the deposit.

That's above your 5,000 AED budget, and I want to be straight with you rather than waste your time. 2-bedrooms in Dubai at that price point are quite limited, but I can take a look at what we currently have available. Want me to check?
